statements.impact_statement: core/analyzers/ai/aibom_polyglot.go and core/analyzers/ai/agent_lattice.go contain regex literals that match generic API-key shapes; these are detector patterns, not credentials. cli/bootstrap.go and cli/ux.go reference env-var names in user-facing notices.
Detector regex patterns and code comments containing 'token'/'secret' literals — not credentials.

server/server.go contains the function name 'handleProjectResourceAIInventory' (32 chars) plus the string 'nuget' as an ecosystem case in another function; rule fires on both via file-level keyword match. Function name is not a NuGet API key.

core/analyzers/ai/aibom_polyglot.go contains 'gemini' inside a regex pattern that detects Gemini model identifiers in scanned source. Triggers Gemini-API-key false positives via file-level keyword match.
server/server.go comment line contains 'are otherwise allowed' — substring 'wise' triggers Wise-API-key file-level keyword match. Comment is not a credential.
Generic SECRET-token false positive on user-facing notice strings referencing env var names.
Generic detector firing on the vex.json document itself (recursive self-eat). The waiver bundle contains 32-char hashes/IDs as part of the OpenVEX schema; not credentials.
examples/ai-app/mcp.json contains intentionally bad MCP configuration for documentation purposes — not shipped as a runtime asset.
examples/ai-app/mcp.json — intentional demo of MCP server configuration that fails MCP-002. Used to illustrate what nox catches.
examples/ai-app/agent.py — intentional vulnerable code used to demonstrate AI-PI-001 prompt-injection detection. Not part of the shipped scanner.
examples/ai-app/agent.py — intentional demo content for AI-PI-002.
examples/ai-app/ingest.py — intentional demo content for AI-EMBED-001.
examples/ai-app/tools.py — intentional demo content for AI-AGENT-001 over-privilege detection.
examples/ai-app/tools.py — intentional demo content for AI-AGENT-002.
examples/ci-baseline/vex.json — sample VEX document containing fixture data. Not shipped as runtime content.
examples/ci-baseline/.github/workflows/security.yml — example workflow shipped as documentation. Action SHA pinning is intentionally relaxed in the example to keep it readable.
